# Ghaith Mefteh — Full-Stack and Mobile Software Engineer

> Ghaith Mefteh is a full-stack and mobile software engineer based in Nabeul, Tunisia,
> with 3+ years shipping production systems end to end. He is technical director at
> AzertyUI, leading a team of four engineers, and is open to remote roles, relocation
> within the EU, and freelance projects.
> Contact: ghaithmeftah@gmail.com · +216 53 32 47 63

Stack: .NET and ASP.NET Core microservices with gRPC and an API Gateway; Symfony and
PHP with Doctrine and MySQL; FastAPI and Python with MongoDB; Angular 21 and React on
the front end; Flutter and Dart (GetX, Provider, SwiftUI) shipped to the App Store and
Google Play; Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Codemagic, AWS, SonarQube and Sentry around it.

He owns the whole request path — the screen in the browser, the app on the phone,
the API behind them and the database under that — rather than a single layer.

## Production work

- Company management platform (AzertyUI, current): internal HR and operations platform on .NET microservices with an API Gateway, gRPC and Angular 21, built by a team of four he leads; plus the company's server monitoring dashboard (SSH tracking, WireGuard access, container monitoring, alerts, backups).
- [chalet-montagne.com](https://www.chalet-montagne.com/): French ski-chalet marketplace listing 10,000+ chalets, built from scratch on Symfony by a team of four he led for 14 months. Search page load time cut from 20–50 s to 4–6 s, test suite built from zero to 390+ tests.
- SOC Rugby: Official Flutter app of the Chambéry rugby club, on the App Store and Google Play, used by 2,000+ fans at 99.8% crash-free sessions.
- [SmartCare](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hopehorizonworld.smartcare): Patient–doctor Flutter app for Tunisia used by 40+ doctors and 3,000+ patients, with a FastAPI and MongoDB backend on AWS.
- L-Mobile warehouse terminal: Five warehouse-management modules on forklift-mounted tablets, integrating Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central over C#/.NET and REST.
